# dependency-risk-score

> Score dependency risk from offline facts: release staleness, maintainer count, deprecation, known vulnerabilities and license category, with reasons and CI exit codes Python package `trysac-dependency-risk-score`, import name `dependency_risk_score`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
